2607.27984.title: Share the Judge, Learn the Deferral: Where Specialization Helps LLM Evaluation
2607.27984.paper_summary: Agentic systems have widened the gap between producing candidate outputs and reviewing them. This paper asks a practical architectural question: should domain specialization be built into an evaluator's weights, or into the rule that decides when its judgment can be trusted? We study 99,952 public, rubric-conditioned examples. Supplying the correct rubric improves locked-test accuracy by 2.11 points over a response-only control; replacing it with an unrelated rubric costs 2.66 points. Dividing the same training corpus among eight criterion-family LoRA judges, however, loses 10.05 points and cuts audited coverage at a 5% risk target from 24.44% to 5.43%. Matching the bank's stored capacity with one rank-64 adapter does not reproduce this loss. Nor is the result explained by learning rate or optimizer steps. Initializing the family adapters from a shared, trained judge recovers test accuracy to 76.85%, 19.94 points above scratch training at the same learning rate (95% interval 18.88-21.02). The result changes when specialization governs deferral rather than judgment. On RewardBench 2, learned correctness heads route examples through a 0.6B-4B-8B cascade without changing any reward score. Across 20 locked repartitions, the cascade attains 89.40% accuracy, compared with 84.75% for 8B alone, at 0.415 normalized parameter compute. Every run passes an exact one-sided 95% risk audit; margin-based rules remain near 84.8% accuracy while using at least 0.94 compute. These results suggest a qualified design rule: share the learning of judgment until there is enough data to justify a split, and place domain-specific adaptation in an audited release boundary.
2607.27984.paper_summary_zh: 代理系統擴大了產生候選輸出與審查它們之間的差距。本文提出了一個實際的架構問題：應該將領域專業化納入評估者的權重中，還是納入決定何時可以信任其判斷的規則中？我們研究了99,952個公共的、基於評分標準的範例。提供正確的評分標準使鎖定測試的準確率提高了2.11點，相較於僅回應的控制組；而用不相關的評分標準替換則損失了2.66點。然而，將相同的訓練語料庫分配給八位標準系列的LoRA評審，卻損失了10.05點，並將在5%風險目標下的審核覆蓋率從24.44%降至5.43%。將銀行的儲存容量與一個rank-64適配器匹配並未重現這一損失。這一結果也無法用學習率或優化器步驟來解釋。從一個共享的、訓練過的評審初始化家庭適配器，使測試準確率回升至76.85%，比相同學習率下的初始訓練高出19.94點（95%區間18.88-21.02）。當專業化主導延遲而非判斷時，結果會改變。在RewardBench 2上，學習到的正確性使路徑範例通過0.6B-4B-8B級聯，而不改變任何獎勵分數。在20次鎖定重分配中，級聯達到了89.40%的準確率，而8B單獨為84.75%，計算參數為0.415。每次運行都通過了精確的一側95%風險審核；基於邊際的規則在使用至少0.94計算時仍然接近84.8%的準確率。這些結果暗示了一條有條件的設計規則：在有足夠數據可以證明分裂之前，共享判斷的學習，並將領域特定的適應放置在經過審核的發布邊界內。
